description: This file defines a React functional component 'TeamsView' responsible for displaying and managing a list of teams, including creating, deleting, viewing details, filtering, sorting, and handling modals related to team operations in a dashboard UI.

methods.name: handleOk
methods.description: Resets and closes the team creation/edit modal, also clears logging and model alias states.

methods.name: handleMemberOk
methods.description: Handles confirmation of member modal actions; resets the member-related modals and forms.

methods.name: handleCancel
methods.description: Closes the team modal and resets related forms and states.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Sets the team to delete and opens a confirmation modal.

methods.name: confirmDelete
methods.description: Performs deletion of the selected team via API call, updates the team list, and manages modal states.

methods.name: cancelDelete
methods.description: Cancels the delete operation and closes the confirmation modal.

methods.name: is_team_admin
methods.description: Checks whether the current user has admin role in the specified team.

methods.name: handleFilterChange
methods.description: Updates filter state and fetches filtered team data.

methods.name: handleSortChange
methods.description: Updates sorting parameters and fetches sorted team data.

methods.name: handleFilterReset
methods.description: Resets filters to default values and refreshes the team list.
